adaptations.reason: DataFusion's SELECT-list unnest expands the same list without a correlated LATERAL table input; named_struct and get_field preserve the nested Arrow values.

FROM (SELECT example.main.nest_tensor(v, {x: x, y: y, z: z}) AS t FROM grid_3d) r,

  FROM (
    SELECT example.main.nest_tensor(v, named_struct('x', x, 'y', y, 'z', z)) AS t
    FROM grid_3d
